blocks.content: Biodiversity refers to the total variety of life on Earth including plants, animals, microorganisms, and the ecosystems they form. It is the result of billions of years of evolutionary processes such as mutation, natural selection, speciation, and adaptation. Biodiversity ensures ecological balance, supports human survival, and contributes to economic development.

items: Evolutionary mechanisms responsible for biodiversity: mutation, natural selection, speciation, and adaptation.
Three key benefits of biodiversity: ecological balance, human survival support, and economic development.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Biodiversity encompasses all life forms on Earth, including plants, animals, microorganisms, and their ecosystems.
It has developed through evolutionary processes over billions of years, driven by mutation, natural selection, speciation, and adaptation.
Biodiversity is essential for maintaining ecological balance, sustaining human life, and driving economic growth.
